decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with large creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The key strategy is to outpace the opponent by cheating big creatures into play early in the game, overwhelming them with powerful threats that are difficult to deal with. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on early disruption and removal through cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares, while also utilizing creatures with strong aggressive abilities like Skyclave Apparition and Solitude. The deck aims to pressure the opponent's life total quickly while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Reanimate and Cling to Dust. The mana base is designed to support a diverse range of spells, including a mix of lands that provide colored mana and utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently control the game by utilizing powerful land cards like Gaea's Cradle and utilizing creatures like Wight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to search for key cards or disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also incorporates cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to bring out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Endurance. Overall, the deck focuses on generating mana, searching for key cards, and controlling the game through its versatile creatures and disruptive elements.

Utilize graveyard manipulation and powerful reanimation spells to quickly bring out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Use disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and control the game. Utilize the flexibility of Brazen Borrower to bounce threats or disrupt the opponent's plans. Use efficient cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for combo pieces and manipulate the top of your deck. Use efficient land destruction like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan.

This deck focuses on disruption and aggression, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Nethergoyf, Orcish Bowmasters, and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Stock Up to keep the pressure on the opponent. With a mix of creature aggression and disruptive spells, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans while quickly putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures. By using a combination of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, along with efficient removal like Fatal Push, the deck aims to protect its threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while also keeping the opponent on the back foot. The inclusion of cards like Reanimate and Stock Up allows for additional versatility and resource management, making it a well-rounded and adaptable aggressive tempo deck.

The main focus of this combo - Doomsday Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to assemble the Doomsday combo using cards like Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and The One Ring. It aims to quickly and efficiently use cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Lion's Eye Diamond to set up a winning Doomsday pile that can be protected using counterspells like Force of Will and Veil of Summer. The deck also includes card filtering and card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the necessary combo pieces.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo, using cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and other fast mana sources to cast Doomsday, set up a winning pile of cards, and then win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as card draw with Ponder and Brainstorm to help find the combo pieces quickly. Murktide Regent provides a threat that can put pressure on the opponent while the combo is being assembled.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back onto the battlefield using Animate Dead. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Daze and Thoughtseize while protecting its combo pieces with Force of Will. Additionally, it utilizes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to dominate the battlefield and secure victory. Wasteland is included to disrupt opponent's mana base, while Brazen Borrower provides additional disruption and tempo advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with efficient spells like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student also helps to provide card advantage and control the board. The deck also includes interaction with removal spells like Fatal Push and disruption with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Force of Will. The mana base is designed to support the various colors needed for the spells while also including utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also setting up its own game plan by drawing cards with Brainstorm and Ponder. The aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Orcish Bowmasters help to close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Nihil Spellbomb provide additional utility and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control and disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying consistent pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes low-cost spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Daze to disrupt the opponent, while also including efficient threats like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Brazen Borrower adds to the deck's tempo advantage, allowing it to outpace the opponent and secure victory. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while ensuring consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Show and Tell with Omniscience or Emrakul, the Aeons Torn to cheat out powerful threats onto the battlefield. The deck includes card selection and manipulation spells like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Cunning Wish to help find the combo pieces. Additionally, protection cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce are included to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The use of cards like Lórien Revealed and Stock Up provide additional utility and card advantage to ensure the combo runs smoothly.

The main strategy of this deck is to use the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to quickly mill your library, putting cards like Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle into the graveyard. This allows for a win condition of either overwhelming the opponent with creatures or winning instantly with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption and control elements such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo or deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Urza's Saga and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional value and utility for the deck.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command to control the board and protect its creatures. With a mix of powerful Eldrazi creatures and efficient mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, this deck aims to establish a strong board presence early in the game and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple allows for fast mana ramping to play larger threats like Thought-Knot Seer.

This combo-focused Painter deck aims to quickly assemble the Grindstone and Painter's Servant combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. The deck includes cards like Goblin Engineer to tutor for combo pieces, Pyroblast for disruption, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to protect the combo. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Barrowgoyf and Pyrogoyf to pressure the opponent while setting up the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently and effectively assemble the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure a win.
